fixesFromReview: Logo 1: flat glass panels read as two screens, so the pages were curved, the lines of text follow the curve and a cover was added; line ends were made ragged so the bookmark annunciator no longer covers text
Logo 2: the front view read as a test-card tile, so the book was turned to a three-quarter view with its cream page edges toward the viewer
Logo 4: an isometric book broke up on the coarse dot grid, so it was redrawn square to the grid and enlarged; light-mode levels were reordered so the brightest dots are the deepest orange
Logo 5: the stack read as synth keyboards, so rounded spines, overhanging boards and a tilted top book were added
Logo 6: enlarged so the book holds its own beside the wordmark
Logo 7: ripples filled the pages, so the book was redrawn on the cell grid with ripples outward only and a fading outer ring
Logo 8: art not composed to the attribute grid left stray clash and a black wedge, so it was redrawn with colour changes on cell edges, clashing only where the ribbon crosses the text and cover
Logo 9: the framed cover read as a tablet, so a banded spine side, a deeper page block with page lines and a ribbon were added
Logo 10: the slip was moved up so both ticked boxes show above the cover
limitations: SVG colours follow the viewer’s system colour scheme, not GitHub’s theme setting.
